columns.comment: Calendar date of the signal (EWS signals - first day of the month evaluated). Today is 30-Sep-2026 (never use CURRENT_DATE); "last N days" means Date between DATE'2026-09-30' minus (N-1) days and DATE'2026-09-30'. Point-in-time measures ordered by Date return the last date of any longer period you group by.
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the signal (EWS signals - first day of the month evaluated) as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the signal (EWS signals - first day of the month evaluated), April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the signal (EWS signals - first day of the month evaluated)).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Signal code, e.g. DEPOSIT_SURPLUS, FX_FLOW_VIA_OTHER_BANK, TRADE_CORRIDOR_GROWTH, CAPEX_NEWS (CRM); UTIL_HIGH, DPD_30, COV_BREACH, NEWS_NEGATIVE (EWS); NEWS_EXPANSION, NEWS_REGULATORY, NEWS_LITIGATION (news topics); MARKET_52W_LOW, MARKET_CDS_WIDENING; EXT_RATING_DOWNGRADE, EXT_OUTLOOK_NEGATIVE; PARENT_RATING_UPGRADE / _DOWNGRADE (Japan share); RM_NOTE_POSITIVE / _NEGATIVE. See gold.dim_signal_type.
columns.name: Signal Type

columns.comment: Opportunity (positive / sales), Risk (negative / early warning) or Neutral. News takes the item sentiment; upgrades are Opportunity, downgrades and negative outlooks Risk.
columns.name: Polarity

columns.comment: Data quadrant of the signal: Internal Quantitative, Internal Qualitative, External Quantitative or External Qualitative.
columns.name: Source Quadrant

columns.comment: Workflow that acts on the signal type: Opportunity Identification, Early Warning or Both.
columns.name: Consumed By

columns.comment: Feed the signal came from: crm_signal (CRM opportunity engine), ews_signal (early-warning engine), news, market (listed-parent market data), ext_rating (agencies), jp_parent_rating (Japan / Tokyo HO Delta Share) or rm_note (RM call notes).
columns.name: Source Feed

columns.comment: JP for signals from the Japan (Tokyo head office) Delta Share - the JP parent rating actions; APAC for local feeds and vendors. "Rating actions from JP-shared parent data" means Source Region = JP.
columns.name: Source Region

columns.comment: True when an RM acknowledged the signal: CRM signals whose status moved beyond New; RM notes (raised by the RM); any other signal when an RM logged an activity with the client group within 30 days after it.
columns.name: Acknowledged

columns.comment: True when the client (group-level signals - the group) has an open pipeline opportunity at 30-Sep-2026 or one created on or after the signal date; false = a signal with no pipeline.
columns.name: Has Pipeline

columns.comment: Signal events on the selected clients and days (a flow).
columns.name: Signals

columns.comment: Mean signal strength 0-1 (CRM engine strength; EWS severity High 1.0 / Medium 0.6 / Low 0.3; news 0.5 x relevance + 0.5 x |sentiment|; size of the market move; rating notches; |note sentiment|).
columns.name: Average Strength

columns.comment: Signals with polarity Opportunity.
columns.name: Opportunity Signals

columns.comment: Signals with polarity Risk (early-warning side).
columns.name: Risk Signals

columns.comment: Signals no RM has acknowledged (see Acknowledged).
columns.name: Unacknowledged Signals

columns.comment: Risk signals with no RM acknowledgement - group by Primary RM for "unacknowledged risk signals by RM".
columns.name: Unacknowledged Risk Signals

columns.comment: Acknowledged signals / all signals (fraction).
columns.name: Acknowledged %

columns.comment: Average days from a signal to its acknowledgement (acknowledged signals only).
columns.name: Average Days to Acknowledge

columns.comment: Signals whose client (group) has no open pipeline opportunity and none created since the signal.
columns.name: Signals Without Pipeline

columns.comment: Client groups with at least one signal in the selection.
columns.name: Groups Signalled

columns.comment: Signals / client groups with signals.
columns.name: Signals per Group

columns.comment: Legal entities (golden clients) with at least one signal in the selection.
columns.name: Clients Signalled

comment: Unified signal feed consumed by Opportunity Identification and Early Warning, Apr-2023 to Sep-2026: every signal on an APAC client from CRM opportunity signals (e.g. DEPOSIT_SURPLUS, TRADE_CORRIDOR_GROWTH), EWS triggers (monthly, e.g. UTIL_HIGH, DPD_30), news items (NEWS_*), market moves on listed parents (MARKET_*), agency rating actions (EXT_RATING_*, EXT_OUTLOOK_NEGATIVE), JP parent rating actions from the Japan share (PARENT_RATING_*) and positive / negative RM notes (RM_NOTE_*): signals, opportunity vs risk signals, average strength 0-1, unacknowledged signals (no RM follow-up), days to acknowledge and signals with no pipeline. Group-level signals (market, agency, JP parent) sit on the group's lead entity. All measures add up over days. Grain: one row per signal event (gold.fact_signal_event).
